_comment: Pass this object as the --detail argument to: uip maestro flow node configure <FLOW>.flow <TRIGGER_NODE_ID> --detail '<JSON>'

_placeholders.CONNECTION_ID: UUID of the Microsoft Office 365 IS connection — obtain with: uip is connections list "microsoft-office-365" --all-folders --output json
_placeholders.FOLDER_KEY: Orchestrator folder key where the connection lives — from the same connections list response
_placeholders.EVENT_MODE: Either "webhooks" or "polling" — read from: uip maestro flow registry get uipath.connector.trigger.microsoft-office-365.email-received --connection-id <CONNECTION_ID> --output json (field: eventMode)
_placeholders.INBOX_FOLDER_ID: Resolved ID of the Inbox mail folder — obtain with: uip is resources run list "microsoft-office-365" "MailFolder" --connection-id <CONNECTION_ID> --output json, then match displayName "Inbox"
_placeholders.FILTER_FIELD_from: Verify the exact field name for the sender address by checking filterFields.fields[].name in the registry get response; commonly "from" or "fromAddress"
_placeholders.FILTER_FIELD_subject: Verify the exact field name for email subject by checking filterFields.fields[].name in the registry get response; commonly "subject"
